errors.quote: dfpON's first differing fire digest falls at that run's first depot ignition in the control

errors.correct: Register the attribution on a fuel-masked observable: e.g. first step at which the per-step BURNING sets differ (reconstructible offline from burn_intervals, already recorded per cell), or a second digest of (burning, burnt) only / excluding depot cells. errors.quote: the harness records ever-burned per cell but not each cell's FINAL state, so how the 25.3 split between burnt_cells and scorched at the end is not recoverable offline

Every one of the 27 outputs/_ffr_f3OFF_*.json has the top-level key fire_ground_final = {'x,y': [has_burned, burnt, burning]} for all 2,500 cells at step 240 (harness :693-701). I recomputed: sum(burnt) equals eval.burnt_cells in 27/27 runs, and depot burnt+scorched+burning equals the burn_intervals ever-burned count in 27/27. The doc itself leans on these 'ground counts (burning 0, burnt 0, has_burned 0)' three lines earlier.
errors.correct: Recoverable today. Of the 682 depot cells that ever burned: 432 end BURNT, 214 scorched, 36 still burning (per run mean 16.0 / 7.9 / 1.3). So the by-construction shift in the eval's burnt_cells is mean 16.0 per run (range 0-24; e.g. east_def_101 = 20, south_half_505 = 7), NOT 25.3; 25.3 is the shift in untouched vegetation. The corpus table lists only the ever-burned count, so it cannot be 'subtracted exactly' from burnt_cells without this split.

errors.quote: each run's burnt + scorched + burning count falls by at least the number of depot cells that burned in ITS control

Source firemech2_report.txt:198-201: median 155, signed sd 276, burned set changes by median 284.5. A whole-grid per-run ONE-SIGNED inequality whose guaranteed term is ~25 cells cannot be pre-registered against re-roll noise ~6x larger with no sign; by the doc's own reasoning it should fail in a large share of the 22 re-rolled runs.
errors.correct: Exact only for the DEPOT-CELL component (0 in dfpON vs that run's dfpDRY/control count). The non-depot remainder is physical + re-roll and must be judged pooled / by pinned-draw replay, as the doc already says for rescued.

errors.problem: 8x8 - 25 = 39 is the Chebyshev-3 (mesa Moore radius 3) count, but influence is cut by EUCLIDEAN distance: distance_rate (common_fixed_variables.py:633-638) returns 0 when m_d > 3, and Wind.apply_wind's off-axis branch (agents.py:243) keeps 0 at 0 (on-axis cells are always within 3). errors.quote: THEREFORE the real arm's fire equals the control's EXACTLY, cell for cell, until the first tick on which a depot cell WOULD have ignited

(b) The fire mechanic must be off: agents.py:2417 reads agent.fuel to build the firebreak/extinguish 'fuel' set, so with FF_FIREFIGHT_* armed depot cells drop out of planning from step 0. (c) 'cell for cell' holds for burning/burnt only; depot fuel and depot cell_prob differ from step 0 / from first exposure.
errors.correct: State the three conditions. No runner overrides FIXED_WIND (checked evaluate_scenarios.py, _ffr_harness.py, serve_dashboard.py) and the mechanic ships OFF, so the claim holds for the planned arms.
